about: .XN--O3CW4H is a country-code top-level domain (ccTLD) in the DNS root zone. It is designated for Thailand. The IANA root zone lists the registry manager as Thai Network Information Center Foundation. Registration policies (who may register, local presence, pricing) are set by the registry and its accredited registrars — not by IANA.
